name: Sebka
description: Sebka netting: a lattice of interlocking lobed diamonds run across the whole wall.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% -1.0%, 101.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 101.0%, -1.0% 50.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% -1.0%, 101.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 101.0%, -1.0% 50.0%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 18.0%, 82.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 82.0%, 18.0% 50.0%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 18.0%, 82.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 82.0%, 18.0% 50.0%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 44%, #000 44%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 44%, #000 44%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
